summary: Turner voted yea on H.R. 6090 in May 2024, the Antisemitism Awareness Act that directs federal education-discrimination enforcement to use the IHRA definition and its examples. In a February 2025 statement, he framed the Gaza conflict as ignited by Hamas on October 7, cited Iran-backed threats to Israel, and called for the US to ensure Gaza peace while addressing the security of both Israelis and Palestinians—an Israel-centric framing that stops short of condemning Israeli military conduct.
